This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 01.
This is second application under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.

Applicants are implicated in connection with Crime No.123/2022 registered at Police Station Kasrawad, District Khargone (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 457, 380, 511, 395, 420, 468 and 471 of the IPC and 25-a, 25-b of Arms Act.

The applicants are in custody since 17.03.2022.
02.
First application of the applicants bearing M.Cr.C. No.42770/2022 was dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 07.09.2022.

sentences.text: As per the prosecution, on 14.03.2022 between 10:00 p.m. to 06:00 a m and particularly at 02:00 a.m., when the security guard of an A.T.M. Machine at S.B.I. Indore road, Kasrawad came back after attending nature's call, he saw that the A.T.M. Machine is cut and cameras are broken.

Thereafter, he made the report on the basis which the investigation was commenced and statements of witnesses were recorded from which it transpired that the applicants alongwith the other co-accused have given effect to the incident.

Thereafter, applicants alongwith the other co-accused were apprehended when they were trying to cross border of the State and were brought in and identified by the security guard, on the basis of which they have been implicated and arrested for the present offence.
0 4 . Learned counsel for applicants submits that the applicants are innocent and have falsely been implicated in the case.
They are in custody since 17.03.2022 and as of now even charges have not been framed by the trial Court.
It is hence apparent that the trial shall take a long time for its conclusion.
It is further submitted that there is no evidence against applicants and their identification by the security guard is wholly suspicious.
Though, the incident is alleged to have occurred on 14.03.2022 but identification has been conducted after two months.
The applicants are willing to abide by such terms and conditions as may be imposed.
On such grounds prayer for grant of bail to the applicants has been made.

05. The aforesaid prayer has been opposed by the learned counsel for the respondent/State submitting that in view of the allegations levelled against the applicants, they are not entitled to be released on bail merely on the basis of their custody period.
06. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and have perused the case diary.
07. The allegation against the applicants is of trying to break into an A.T.M. Machine and stealing cash from it.
The applicants have been identified by the security guard after about two months.
There is no CCTV footage of the incident as the same is alleged to have been broken.
The applicants are in custody since 17.03.2022 and as of now the charge itself has not been framed hence it is evident that the trial shall take a long time for its conclusion.
Further custodial interrogation of the applicants is no longer required.
Thus in my opinion, the applicants deserve to be enlarged on bail.
08. Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicants is allowed.

The applicants are directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh) with two solvent sureties of Rs.50,000/- each out of which one shall be local surety the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for their regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that they shall remain present before the Court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
09.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial, however, in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
